page.overview:
Who is Curse of Crows minor characters?

The following is a list of minor characters in that haven't been mentioned elsewhere, and/or have too little information on them to warrant their own page.

Fredd was a thug living in Novigrad a few years after the Third Nilfgaard War ended.

He tended to have a group of thugs that always hung out with him that was well known for hitting on women and all but threatening them when refused. This turned out to not end well for Fredd and company when they crossed Ciri's path, resulting in the whole group being knocked out by the witcher.

Gramlot worked at one of Maerlina's bathhouses in Novigrad, notably the one that her daughter, Elisa, was put in charge of. Due to Elisa's dislike of most men harassing her and other young women in the city, it's likely Gramlot didn't cause them any trouble to be employed there.
